item.title: Iran War Live Updates: U.S. to Blockade Ships From Iranian Ports
item.summary: The blockade on ships “entering or departing Iranian ports and coastal areas” will begin on Monday, U.S. Central Command said. But U.S. forces will not impede vessels transiting the Strait of Hormuz, a step back from President Trump’s earlier vow.

item.title: In Pakistan Talks, Iran Saw a U.S. Trying to Dictate, Not Negotiate
item.summary: Iran sees American demands as reaching far beyond what the United States achieved in war. Tehran is gambling that it can withstand further bombardment more than Washington is willing to sustain economic chaos, experts say.

item.title: Cuba’s President Projects Defiance in Standoff With the U.S.
item.summary: Miguel Díaz-Canel’s stance on “Meet the Press” reflected how Cuba is digging in against pressure from a Trump administration distracted by the war in Iran.

item.title: Inside Tyre, a Lebanese City Bombarded by Israel
item.summary: In Tyre, a city on Lebanon’s coast, near-daily bombardments by Israel have killed and injured civilians, and left many searching for shelter.

item.title: [PENDING_TRANSLATION] How Would a Blockade of the Strait of Hormuz Work? Here Are Some Possibilities.
item.summary: The goal of the naval operation ordered by ordered by President Trump is to deny Iran the revenues it needs to fund its military, but there are many unknowns.

item.title: Scores Killed in Nigerian Military Strikes as Clashes With Militants Intensify
item.summary: Nigerian officials said they attacked a terrorist enclave, but locals and rights groups said the airstrikes hit a popular market, killing many civilians.

item.title: Israel’s War
item.summary: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu was instrumental in taking the U.S. to war with Iran. Now, he is trying to prolong the fighting.

item.title: Iran’s Underground Air Force Base Was Hit Earlier in the War
item.summary: Satellite imagery shows impact craters at and near the tunnel entrances to aircraft shelters at Iran’s remote “Eagle 44” base.

item.title: An Underwater Phantom Is Killing Fish and Breaking Hearts
item.summary: A mysterious algal bloom has haunted South Australia’s coast for more than a year, killing marine life and unsettling communities that cherish the ocean.

item.title: The ‘Islamabad Peace Talks’ Are Over. What Now for Pakistan?
item.summary: With the U.S. and Iranian delegations gone from Islamabad and the cease-fire uncertain, Pakistan faces its own economic and diplomatic challenges.
